section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces gratitude as a positive emotion linked to social relationships and well-being, and loneliness as a distressing experience with health implications, particularly for older adults. The current study, referred to as 'Study X', aims to experimentally test a gratitude cultivation intervention (the 'three good things' exercise) to reduce loneliness and improve self-reported health in older individuals living in subsidized housing in the USA. This is highlighted as the first experimental test of gratitude's impact on loneliness in this demographic.
